description: Combine the direct-FP32 cached n=2048 and specialized n=1024 global-best stack with the lane-correct cp.async paired-accumulator staging for batch-640 n=512. Import only the asynchronous n=512 source staging, its required synchronization, and shape-local launch state; preserve every n=256/n=1024/n=2048 and large-shape path, then validate resets, repeated outputs, caller-stream ordering, fresh inputs, and the full grid.

Imported the full lane-correct cp.async paired-accumulator n512 pipeline from the second parent while retaining the first parent's specialized n1024, cached direct-FP32 n2048, and other dispatches; full validation and fresh-input guard passed; full-grid geomean 926.962 us with batch640 n512 at 1865.301 us.

Cached the batch640 n512 Numba launch configuration by caller-stream handle and batch, rebuilding only on stream changes while retaining the asynchronous paired source staging. Full validation and fresh-input guard passed; target improved from 1865.301 to 1775.895 us and full-grid geomean from 926.962 to 919.556 us.

Cached the transposed n512 result tensor alongside its data/output Numba views so repeated calls returned the same shape-local view object. Validation and all guards passed; target measured 1819.365 us versus 1775.895 without the cached result view, and full-grid geomean measured 926.297 versus 919.556.

Moved the required CTA barrier into the linked cp.async wait primitive and removed the two redundant Numba-level barrier sites, while dropping the slower cached result view and retaining the stream-keyed launcher. Full validation passed; target measured 1776.613 us and aggregate 919.391 us versus 1775.895/919.556 for separate wait and barrier.

Added L2::128B prefetch hints to each warp-coalesced 4-byte cp.async row segment while retaining the fused wait/barrier and stream-keyed launcher. Full validation passed; target measured 1780.170 us versus 1776.613 without the hint, while the noisy full-grid aggregate measured 917.179 us versus 919.391.

Consolidated paired cp.async issue, three FP32-to-FP16 factor conversions, wait, and barrier into one linked helper per staging site. Build and 17-shape validation passed, but the active batch640 n512 benchmark correctly failed during specialization because this edit also removed the local shared index from the separate synchronous paired-panel store; no complete metric was emitted.

Restored the synchronous paired-panel shared index and measured the corrected single-helper async/conversion pipeline. Build, validation, fresh-input guard, and all 15 cells passed; target measured 1852.750 us versus 1780.170 for separate linked issue/wait helpers, and full-grid aggregate measured 926.572 versus 917.179.

Measured seven combine variants plus one correctly logged target-specialization failure. The direct import reached 1865.301 us target / 926.962 us aggregate. Stream-keyed Numba launch caching reached 1775.895 / 919.556 at eb9be58; fusing wait plus CTA barrier measured 1776.613 / 919.391 at e2a183d. L2::128B async hints produced the best aggregate 917.179 at 6808886 with a 1780.170 target, though unrelated cells contributed to the aggregate movement. Cached result views measured 1819.365 / 926.297. Consolidating async issue, factor conversion, wait, and barrier first exposed an active-grid-only missing-index compile failure, then passed after repair at d2290f4 but measured 1852.750 / 926.572. Every succeeded variant passed build, policy gates, 17 official tests, fresh-input guard, and all 15 cells; repeated benchmark calls exercised cache reuse, while launch caching rebinds by current caller-queue handle. Local profiling was waived and hosted Brev was unavailable. Keep this objective moving from 6808886 or eb9be58 with repeated-noise confirmation of the L2 hint, a shape-scoped FP16 factor sidecar for async prior-factor triples, device-LTO/inlined wait primitives, cp.async.bulk/TMA+mbarriers, and an explicit multi-queue/reset guard when remote harness support is available.
